attribution.source_policy: engine/src/metric.rs:310,354-357 intentionally withholds every frontier on interrupted sweeps; engine/src/search.rs:445-449 marks None probes as interrupted; engine/src/run.rs:566-603 defines None probe cases.
attribution.observed: All seven raw cells have sweep_max_proxy_interrupted=true. Final retained clean rungs are at concurrency 128 or 256, with multi-second tails. Full run log contains no explicit spawn, rig-refused or stats parse diagnostic.
attribution.inference: An empty measured window is the remaining silent None branch (ok=0 and fail=0). Treat missing throughput boundaries as a rig-window limitation; no gateway ceiling is established. The interrupted window raw stats and responses are not retained, so this is a source-based inference, not a directly observed cause.
attribution.unresolved: Need explicit publication decision after source-based interruption review; do not recompute a frontier from partial rungs or rerun.

publication_resolution: Owner requested metric-scoped explanations instead of withholding the whole run. Raw observations, values, failures and original absence classifications are unchanged; only public absence details clarify evidence limits.
